rawIndexableTextContent: A local filesystem cloud backend for Ensembles. Overview EnsemblesLocalFile provides LocalCloudFileSystem, an implementation of the Ensembles CloudFileSystem protocol that stores sync data in a local directory. This is useful for testing, for syncing between apps on the same device, or for network-attached storage scenarios.
title: EnsemblesLocalFile
summary: A local filesystem cloud backend for Ensembles.

rawIndexableTextContent: A cloud file system backed by the local file system using FileManager. Useful for local syncing, testing, or shared-folder syncing scenarios.
title: LocalCloudFileSystem
summary: A cloud file system backed by the local file system using FileManager. Useful for local syncing, testing, or shared-folder syncing scenarios.
